title: Arabs, Ghaznavids and Ghori: added detail

boxes.title: Rulers: more
items: Ghurid dates **1173-1206**; Mahmud built the **Ghazni minarets**
**Aibak**: Ghori's slave, **Master of Stables**; Sultanate **1206-1526** (Mamluk, Khalji, Tughlaq, Sayyid, **Lodi**)
Bakhtiyar: Bihar **1193-1203**, Bengal **1198-1203**; took **Odantpur**, ruled from **Lakhnauti**
Arab writers: **Pratihara cavalry** most formidable in India

boxes.title: Motives & debates
items: Mahmud: political expansion, temple wealth for the state, **Punjab**, prestige
Raids exposed India's weakness; opened the **north-west frontier**
==**R.S. Sharma**==: "Indian feudalism", sub-infeudation, closed village economy
Caste confined fighting to a few groups
